entities.name: Oris
entities.role: Incidental crusader spearman named once on the company roll; no unique canon office
entities.introducing_text: ch("felt", '{n}You open the company roll between you. Sergeant Venn, spearman Oris, scout Desrani: you read each name aloud, all the way to the last. Chadali repeats the names she catches herself stumbling over. Then she holds your hand beside the signed order.{/n}\n"Now you know whom you\'re sending. So do I. Bring this back afterwards. I want to know who returned."',

entities.name: Neris
entities.introducing_text: "This is Neris. She heard a verse I was trying."

entities.name: Deren
entities.introducing_text: "His name was Deren. He was my brother. He left us before the fighting began. I waited at the gate because he told me to. I waited until I could see the smoke coming down the street. I don't know where he went. Don't give him a brave death because it's easier to sing."

entities.name: Vessa
entities.introducing_text: n("room", "Narrator", '''{n}The room stands behind a storehouse. An adult woman named Vessa is sweeping it while a man lifts broken boards through the doorway. She has kept two sound sleeping platforms and a table that needs a wedge beneath one leg.{/n}

entities.name: Mera
entities.introducing_text: "Mera is teaching me. She's the carpenter. Orsa does the washing. They've both said you can come, provided you don't mind being told where to stand."''',

entities.name: Hessa
entities.introducing_text: "Hessa. She says she has been paid to examine the construction, and would like me to stop improving it until she has finished."''', c('"Let her begin."', "underneath")),

entities.name: Venn
entities.introducing_text: ch("felt", '{n}You open the company roll between you. Sergeant Venn, spearman Oris, scout Desrani: you read each name aloud, all the way to the last. Chadali repeats the names she catches herself stumbling over. Then she holds your hand beside the signed order.{/n}\n"Now you know whom you\'re sending. So do I. Bring this back afterwards. I want to know who returned."',

entities.name: Tessa
entities.introducing_text: "Tessa knows a fiddler. The daughter of one of her regular players. Her name is Veska. She will play a few dances in exchange for supper."

entities.name: Mervika
entities.introducing_text: {n}Her hands close on the stick. Outside, Mervika cuts another spoiled length of cord.{/n}

entities.name: Merovan
entities.introducing_text: "I have been writing to you from the wayhouse on the eastern road, about doors and cups and a sergeant called Merovan. Then the chaplain wrote that you kept the rows supplied and worked beside him all night, and the chaplain's letter found me at the wayhouse. I walked in to see whether it was the same hand that writes to me."''',

entities.name: Edrava
entities.introducing_text: n("recognition", "Narrator", '''{n}A woman carrying a covered basket recognizes Kiana and stops. Kiana introduces her as Edrava, who lives beside Lenna's workshop. Edrava gives you a startled nod and nearly dislodges the cloth covering her basket.{/n}

entities.name: Edritha
entities.introducing_text: {n}Arsinoe takes you to the cooper's empty workroom. Orvena has brought her estimate. The cooper, Senn, stands behind a stool as though it might protect him from the figure written on the page. Beside the open door waits Edritha, who rents the rooms on the passage's other side.{/n}

entities.name: Dervan
entities.introducing_text: {n}The man with the boards introduces himself as Dervan. He has a flattened nose, broad hands, and the habit of looking toward the door whenever someone speaks sharply outside.{/n}

entities.name: Selvra
entities.introducing_text: n("claim", "Gesmerha", '''"Selvra. Halvek's sister. She has a sharper tongue and better reasons for using it than he would prefer."

entities.name: Selruna
entities.introducing_text: "There is a route-maker in the city. Selruna. She has a collection of old road drawings, some useful and some apparently intended to make travelers admire the artist. I asked whether she would show me how she chooses between them."

entities.name: Selvani
entities.role: passage resident caring for her sister's children
entities.introducing_text: "This is Selvani's passage," {n}she says.{/n} "She has her sister's children tonight. If she comes out, we finish."

entities.name: Hesvara
entities.introducing_text: {n}The woman gives her name as Hesvara. Her hand stays on Tarn's back as he tries the injured foot. Soana watches him stand.{/n}

entities.name: Desrani
entities.introducing_text: ch("felt", '{n}You open the company roll between you. Sergeant Venn, spearman Oris, scout Desrani: you read each name aloud, all the way to the last. Chadali repeats the names she catches herself stumbling over. Then she holds your hand beside the signed order.{/n}\n"Now you know whom you\'re sending. So do I. Bring this back afterwards. I want to know who returned."',

entities.name: Veldran
entities.role: captive crusader on the ransom list
entities.introducing_text: "My broker has mistaken my protection for his property. Return his protection payment. Deliver Orren, Davit, Hald, Marten, Veldran and Rul. Alive. Should he find this ruinous, remind him what my displeasure costs."

entities.name: Vennorik
entities.introducing_text: n("meeting", "Narrator", '''{n}The storehouse is crowded with people who came to dispute different things. Builders sit beside residents whose homes have been marked. A clerk guards a locked case of original assessments. At the far end, an organizer named Vennorik has arranged the chairs so that the petition's supporters face the door.{/n}

entities.name: Tesvara
entities.role: older traveler needing a warm sleeping place
entities.introducing_text: n("early", "Narrator", '''{n}The older traveler introduces herself as Tesvara. She is grateful for help with her bundle and less grateful for suggestions about where to put her painful leg. Ember stops giving those when Tesvara asks, then holds the cushion where she points.{/n}

pending_entities.name: Nerethi
pending_entities.introducing_text: Your clerk Neris has held it back from the incoming petitioners. She asks whether the seal is yours.

pending_entities.name: Vezhara
pending_entities.introducing_text: p("{n}Vessa's damaged hand never vanished from the account of the narrower crossing. The crushed bell went back to her; Nocticula kept the broken instrument and sent away buyers who mistook it for a working road.{/n}", requires=("noct.door_unreinforced", "noct.vessa_injured", "noct.chart_lost")),

pending_entities.name: Merzila
pending_entities.introducing_text: Edris cuts the ribbon rather than pulling against its hidden hook. The freed attendant runs into the yard. Her sister, Mera, remains beside the cabinet.
